info.name: Smart Travel Planner API
info.description: Backend API collection for the Smart Travel Planner. Set base_url, then run the Authentication folder (or install the environment and send Login). Test scripts populate access tokens, place IDs, itinerary/review/notification IDs, and share tokens as you run requests. A collection pre-request script sets future trip dates automatically. No secrets are stored in this collection. Requests are grouped by module; destructive DELETE requests are labelled and should be run last.

request.description: Does not call paid external APIs.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth). Tokens are stored in the environment, never in this collection.

request.description: Exchanges the 7-day session token (refresh_token from register/login) for a fresh 15-minute access JWT. The session token does not rotate.
Revokes the Neon Auth session identified by refresh_token (the 7-day session token). Run this last, or re-authenticate before continuing.
Open authorization_url in a browser. Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth) performs the OAuth exchange itself and redirects the user to redirect_to (a registered trusted domain).

item.name: Users
item.description: Profile, preferences, history, and saved destinations.

request.description: The place is verified through Google Places before saving.
Destructive: removes the saved destination identified by {{place_id}}.

item.name: Destinations and Routes
item.description: Google Places (New), Geocoding, photo proxy, and Routes.

item.name: Itineraries
item.description: AI generation, CRUD, sharing, and PDF export.

request.description: Days must be contiguous, include exactly one entry for every date between the itinerary start and end dates, and stay within those dates.
The raw token is returned once. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.
Tokens are never returned by this endpoint.
Destructive: revokes every active public share link for this itinerary.
Destructive: deletes the itinerary, its days/activities, and all share links. Run after share/PDF requests.

item.name: Recommendations
item.description: Deterministic ranking of real Google Places results.

item.name: Weather
item.description: Observed weather and honest forecast coverage.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: User reviews for verified Google Places locations.

body.raw:
{
  "place_id": "{{place_id}}",
  "rating": 5,
  "title": "Beautiful place",
  "comment": "Go early; it gets crowded later.",
  "visited_on": "{{visited_on}}"
}

request.description: Destructive: deletes the review identified by {{review_id}}.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications. A trip_generated notification is created after generation.

request.description: Destructive: deletes the notification identified by {{notification_id}}.

item.name: Public Sharing
item.description: Read-only public view. The token is a bearer secret; do not log or post it.

request.description: No authentication. Invalid, expired, revoked, or deleted-itinerary links return 404.
